title: En-V Arcade Vanilla +
description: The official client modpack for the En-V Arcade network. Adds proximity voice chat, custom menus, and built-in textures for a clean, immersive experience—no setup required.
body:
This pack is made for players who join the En-V Arcade Minecraft Network.
It keeps things simple, fast, and easy to use, with just a few quality-of-life additions:

- Simple Voice Chat — Talk with other players in real-time using proximity chat

- FancyMenu — Custom home screen and loading menus to match the network’s style

- Performance Mods — Boost framerate and reduce stutter without changing gameplay

- Resource Packs — All the textures used on the network are included automatically

- No extra mods. No bloat. Just what you need to enjoy the game the way we built it.

This pack is here to make your life easier and get to playing on the Network with ease.
